stage: T3 persistent binding reliability and local-neighborhood qualification
reciprocal: exchange fit and held using unchanged original bind_track checks; same ID or surface-equivalent trajectory
visibility: native full-scene depth sorting; one-hot original row encoded per channel; alpha/D invariant
visibility_ratio: sum row compositing contribution over 5x5 tracked UV patch divided by sum full joint alpha; not a foreground label
neighborhood: up to eight nearest dynamic persistent rows at middle frame, within0.05; all12 distances<=0.05 and relative displacement RMS<=0.02; no relaxed search or topology growth
no_mutation: model, twoAdam/bindings, RNG, camera remainder and physics graphs exactly unchanged
unknown_policy: occluded, missing, split-ambiguous and surface-equivalence unknown retained; no relabeling as background or dynamic
